tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in Welile user's profile: name, phone, verification status, and location.

tools.name: get_my_wallet
tools.title: Get my wallet balance
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's Welile wallet: withdrawable balance (the amount they can withdraw) plus float and advance buckets. Amounts are in UGX.

tools.name: list_my_transactions
tools.title: List my recent transactions
tools.description: List the signed-in user's most recent wallet ledger entries (deposits, withdrawals, commissions). Amounts are in UGX.

limit.description: How many recent entries to return. Defaults to 20; capped at 100.

tools.name: get_my_wallet_statement
tools.title: View my wallet statement
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's Welile wallet statement for an optional date range: every wallet ledger entry with money-in / money-out totals, net movement and the current withdrawable balance. Amounts are in UGX.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to include. Defaults to 200; capped at 1000.

tools.name: export_my_wallet_statement
tools.title: Export my wallet statement
tools.description: Generate the signed-in user's Welile wallet statement as a PDF, Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file and return a private download link valid for 7 days. Optionally limit it to a date range. Amounts are in UGX.

format.description: File format to generate. Defaults to pdf.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to include. Defaults to 200; capped at 1000.
